cursor.frontmatter:
name: branch-create
description: >-
  Creates and checks out one branch from origin/dev or origin/release, named
  type/version_slug. Use when the user names branch-create or asks to open a
  branch from dev or release, including a hotfix off release. Does not rename,
  switch to an existing branch, create a worktree, commit, or push. Asks
  before creating unless the user already said to create it directly.
disable-model-invocation: true
